listing.name: WTF: Work Time Fun (game-sharing microgames) — wtf-psp-recomp (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: Lumberjack reaches the paycheck, and Pendemonium is reported playable. The main EBOOT has not been attempted. Audio-device output is absent. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA UMD/PSN dump; encrypted b02/b04 PBP microgame modules, external pspdecrypt

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract, decrypt, generate code and build locally using the project’s instructions. Each microgame has a separate executable; this does not establish that the full anthology is playable.

warnings: Lumberjack reaches the paycheck, and Pendemonium is reported playable. The main EBOOT has not been attempted. Audio-device output is absent.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
